subject.title: feat(cli): list and resolve pending approvals headlessly

question: Should OpenClaw expose terminal and script clients as a first-class approval-resolution surface with the proposed operator-admin enumeration contract and dedicated approval-resolution scope?
rationale: This is a new privileged public CLI workflow, not a repair of an established command contract; maintainers must choose the supported operator and third-party-client boundary before merge.

options.title: Sponsor the headless CLI contract
options.body: Accept terminal approval management as a supported workflow after completing scope/redaction review and real Gateway proof.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Keep resolution but revise enumeration, scopes, output, or scripting semantics to a smaller maintainer-approved contract.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR until the approval-management product and authorization boundary have a settled owner direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the headless CLI contract
recommendation.body: Accept terminal approval management as a supported workflow after completing scope/redaction review and real Gateway proof.
